title: SD PUC Order — Docket EL26-002: In the Matter of MidAmerican Energy Company’s Application for Approval of Its 2025 Reconciliation and 2026 Transmission Cost Recovery Factors
text:
BEFORE THE PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION 
OF THE STATE OF SOUTH DAKOTA 
IN THE MATTER OF MIDAMERICAN ENERGY 
) 
COMPANY'S APPLICATION FOR APPROVAL 
) 
OF ITS 2024 RECONCILIATION AND 2025 
) 
TRANSMISSION COST RECOVERY FACTORS 
) 
ORDER APPROVING TARIFF 
REVISIONS 
EL25-004 
On February 14, 2025, the South Dakota Public Utilities Commission (Commission) 
received MidAmerican Energy Company's (MidAmerican) filing for approval of tariff revisions 
regarding its Transmission Cost Recovery (TCR) 2024 Reconciliation and 2025 New Factor 
Calculation. MidAmerican's TCR mechanism was established in the company's most recent rate 
case, EL 14-072. With this filing, MidAmerican is establishing new TCR rates based on true ups 
to the actual over/under recovery from 2024, 2025 forecasted Midcontinent Independent System 
Operator transmission expense, and the forecasted over/under recovery for January through 
March of 2025. MidAmerican requested the new TCR factors have an effective date of April 1, 
2025. 
On February 20, 2025, the Commission electronically transmitted notice of the filing and 
the intervention deadline of March 7, 2025, to interested entities and persons on the 
Commission's PUC Weekly Filings electronic listserv. No petitions to intervene or comments were 
filed. On February 27, 2025, MidAmerican filed a revised application with a revised 2024 TCR 
Reconciliation and 2025 New Factor Calculation and corresponding workpapers. 
The revised tariff sheet, effective for service rendered on or after April 1, 2025, is as 
follows: 
South Dakota Electric Tariff Schedule No. 2 
SD P.U.C. Sec. No. 3 
1 0'h Revised Sheet No. 73 
Canceling 9th Revised Sheet No. 73 
The Commission has jurisdiction over this matter pursuant to SDCL Chapter49-34A, 
specifically 49-34A-4, 49-34A-6, 49-34A-8, 49-34A-10, 49-34A-12, and 49-34A-25.1 through 
SDCL 49-34A-25.4, and ARSD 20: 10: 13. 
At its regularly scheduled meeting on March 25, 2025, the Commission considered this 
matter. Commission staff recommended approval of the revised TCR rate factors and revised 
tariff sheet with an effective date of April 1, 2025. Having thoroughly reviewed the filings in the 
docket, the Commission found the TCR rates and tariff revisions to be just and reasonable. The 
Commission voted unanimously to approve the revised TCR rate factors and revised tariff sheet 
with an effective date of April 1, 2025. It is therefore 
ORDERED, that the revised TCR rate factors and revised tariff sheet set forth above are 
approved effective April 1, 2025. 

Dated at Pierre, South Dakota, this Jt?' day of March 2025.
